_about: T-210 batch 3 (DRAFT, built in the 2026-10-02 goal loop): the rest of the water-typed families, named by their own type's register (vision.md 2.9). SEALEO > WALREIN is its own two-stage line: T-234 rerouted SPHEAL (PENGUIN) to evolve by trade into PENPHIN, so nothing evolves into SEALEO any more and it does not grow out of PENGUIN.

daemons.name: TEMPO
content: It drifts on the water and takes one
small step each time the current
pulses. It never hurries.
context: It keeps to a rhythm nobody set.
It would be lost without one.

daemons.name: CADENCE
content: Its steps start large and shrink as
it nears what it wants, then grow
again to look somewhere new.
context: It slows down when it is close. Most
things speed up. It has learned
better.

daemons.name: CYCLICAL
content: It dances in rising and falling
waves, and every turn of the dance
settles it somewhere a little better.
context: Those who hear its rhythm start to
move with it. Nobody remembers
deciding to.

daemons.name: PARTICLE
content: Hundreds skate the pond at once,
each pulled toward its own best spot
and toward the best that any found.
context: None of them knows where the best
place is. Together they find it.

daemons.name: FLOCKING
content: It steers by three rules: keep close,
do not collide, go where the others
go. The eyes on its wings watch them.
context: The flock turns as one and no bird
in it decided to turn.

daemons.name: OLDBRANCH
content: It grows on its own, away from the
rest of the reef. Break a branch off
and it simply grows another.
context: Nobody joined it back to the main
reef. It kept growing anyway, and
now nobody knows how.

daemons.name: BIFURCATE
content: It keeps one pearl shut inside and
waits. What it is given decides which
of two ways it opens.
context: It could become either. The choice is
made for it by whatever it is
holding at the time.

daemons.name: DEEPWELL
content: It lives at the bottom of the
narrowest, deepest hollow in the sea.
One nudge and it is somewhere else.
context: It is the lowest thing for miles, and
it does not travel well.

daemons.name: SHALLOWS
content: It rests in a wide, gentle hollow.
Nudge it any way and it stays almost
exactly as low.
context: It was never the deepest. It is the
one still there when the water
changes.

daemons.name: CONFLUENCE
content: It swims where two currents meet and
join. It is always found in pairs,
drifting the same way.
context: After two streams meet, nobody can
say which water came from which.

daemons.name: STILLRUN
content: It has run without stopping since
before anything else in the sea was
built. Nobody dares to switch it off.
context: Everything around it was replaced.
It was not. Nobody remembers what
depends on it.

daemons.name: STOPGRAD
content: The water around it stops moving. It
can be pushed, but nothing it learns
passes back through it.
context: It is not stubborn. Something
decided it should no longer change.

daemons.name: PERMAFROST
content: The ground under it has not thawed
in an age. Whatever flowed there
once is still held, exactly as it was.
context: Dig in and you find what it learned
long ago, perfectly kept, and no
longer true.
